title: Radio Group
api:
interface RadioGroupItem {
  value: string
  label: string
  description?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

interface RadioGroupProps extends Omit<
  BaseRadioGroup.Props<string>,
  'children' | 'className' | 'value' | 'defaultValue' | 'onValueChange'
> {
  items: RadioGroupItem[]
  value?: string
  defaultValue?: string
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void
  className?: string
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
}

function RadioGroup({
  items,
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onValueChange,
  disabled,
  readOnly,
  className,
  id,
  size = 'md',
  'aria-describedby': describedBy,
  'aria-invalid': invalid,
  ...props
}: RadioGroupProps);
